policy.exact: identity of sorted Solidity source digests and comment/pragma-stripped normalized text
policy.near: undirected edge for exact normalized text or strong whole-source 7-gram Jaccard, then use connected components
policy.threshold_version: lexical >=0.80 with length ratio >=0.80, or identifier-normalized >=0.92 AND lexical >=0.62 with length ratio >=0.88
policy.development: R4 five main and two additional genuine members; also conservatively record Direction2 48 and R2 holdout members that were actually investigated during R3/R4
policy.holdout: no tracked Direction2 exposure in that family; present member-weighted and one source-neutral representative per family; no guarantee of source-level independence outside tracked materials
